The successful applicant will maintain food quality, hygiene, and safety standards while supporting the efficient operation of the commercial kitchen.    Salary   AUD 79,423 to AUD 85,000 per annum, plus superannuation.   Key Responsibilities    Examine foodstuffs to ensure quality.  Prepare and cook food in accordance with recipes and menu requirements.  Regulate temperatures of ovens, grills, fryers and other cooking equipment.  Season food during preparation and cooking.  Portion food and present meals with sauces and garnishes.  Store food in temperature-controlled facilities and monitor food preservation and stock rotation.  Prepare meals to accommodate special dietary requirements.  Assist with menu planning and estimating food requirements.  Monitor stock levels and advise on ingredient requirements.  Maintain food safety, hygiene and workplace health and safety standards.  Assist in training junior kitchen staff where required.    Skills and Experience   The successful applicant should possess:   AQF Certificate III in Commercial Cookery or equivalent overseas qualification.   At least one year of relevant post-qualification experience, or equivalent industry experience.  Demonstrated ability to prepare and cook a wide range of dishes in a commercial kitchen.  Knowledge of food preparation techniques, portion control, and presentation.  Sound understanding of food safety, sanitation, and HACCP principles.  Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced hospitality environment.  Strong teamwork, communication, and time management skills.  Flexibility to work rotating rosters, including weekends and public holidays.    What We Offer    Full-time permanent employment.  Competitive salary plus superannuation.  A supportive and professional team environment.  Opportunities for ongoing training and career development.  A safe and well-equipped commercial kitchen.  Stable employment with an established hospitality business in South Australia.    Application Process   Applicants must submit a resume and a cover letter outlining their relevant experience and suitability for the role.  All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.  The Highlander Hotel is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse workforce.  About Company    Highlander Hotel is an established hospitality business located in South Australia, operating under Tartan Proprietary Limited, an Australian private company registered since 1969 with an active ABN and ongoing business operations.  The business operates in the hospitality industry, providing hotel accommodation, food and beverage, and customer services to the local community and visitors. It continues to trade as an active Australian private company in South Australia. The company is committed to delivering quality guest experiences through professional service, comfortable accommodation, and a welcoming environment while maintaining high standards of operational excellence, workplace safety, and customer satisfaction. The job requires carrying out motor vehicle inspections, servicing, maintenance, diagnostics, and repairs on a range of customer vehicles and company fleet vehicles, ensuring they are safe, reliable, and maintained to the highest industry standards.   Benefits  What We Offer   Full-time permanent position (38 hours per week)  Overtime opportunities during busy periods  Superannuation in accordance with Australian legislation  Ongoing training and opportunities for career advancement  Supportive and professional team environment    Task & responsibilities   Diagnose and rectify mechanical and electrical faults across a variety of vehicle makes and models. result.description: Desire Constructions Australia Pty Ltd  As a Bricklayer with Descon, you will be responsible for executing high-standard bricklaying work across our various residential sites   Benefits  Lucrative pay, opportunities for growth and further training and skills development   Task & responsibilities  Key Responsibilities  As a Bricklayer with Descon, you will be responsible for executing high-standard bricklaying work across our various residential sites. Your day-to-day tasks will include:      Setting out brickwork in accordance with plans, drawings, and specifications  Laying bricks for residential  projects  Mixing and preparing mortar to correct ratios and specifications  Constructing walls, piers, footings, and structural brickwork  Installing cavity walls, damp-proof courses (DPC), and wall ties  Cutting, shaping, and trimming bricks using hand and power tools  Ensuring brickwork is level, plumb, and aligned using spirit levels and string lines  Reading and interpreting construction plans and job specifications  Repairing, restoring, and replacing damaged brickwork  Cleaning excess mortar and finishing brickwork to required standards  Coordinating with site supervisors, builders, and other trades  Loading, unloading, and handling bricks and materials safely  Maintaining tools, equipment, and a clean, safe worksite  Complying with WHS regulations and site safety requirements    Qualification & experience  A successful candidate needs to meet the following requirements:      At least AQF Certificate III in Bricklaying (or equivalent).  At least two years of full-time (or part-time equivalent) Work Experience in a similar position.  South Australian Bricklaying Contractor Licence (held or eligible to hold).  Full/Unrestricted Class C South Australian Driver Licence (or interstate equivalent).   About Company    Descon Bricklaying is a premier South Australian bricklaying firm dedicated to high-quality residential construction. Built on a foundation of precision and skill, we pride ourselves on delivering exceptional bricklaying across Adelaide and surrounding regions. As a fully licensed South Australian Building Work Contractor, we have established a reputation for reliability, safety, and clear communication, ensuring every project is “Built on Skill and Finished with Pride.”     At Descon Bricklaying, we don’t just stack bricks; we build long-term relationships with the state’s leading builders and developers. Our team works on a diverse range of residential builds and projects around Adelaide and surrounding regions. We are currently looking for motivated tradespeople who share our passion for craftsmanship and want to grow their careers within a professional, safety-conscious, and supportive environment.
